facts.value: ASU Health Services offers medical care to ASU students provided by board-certified doctors and nurse practitioners on all four metro Phoenix campuses.
ASU Health Services offers many health care services to ASU students, including primary care, immunizations, women’s health care, lab services and more.
You can also get affordable medical insurance through ASU.
The freshman 15 refers to the modest amount of weight that many new students gain when they start college.
All ASU students get automatic membership to the Sun Devil Fitness Complex.
The Sun Devil Fitness Complex offers weights, cardio and exercise classes on each campus.
By making smart food choices and getting regular exercise, you shouldn’t have too much trouble avoiding the freshman 15.

As a first-year student, you’ll live on the campus of your degree program in a residential college community. Living and learning communities are organized by major, so your roommate and neighbors will also be your classmates. You’ll have access to tutoring, advising, events, staff members and other academic resources just steps away from your new home.
A GPA or grade point average is the average of letter grades (A = 4, B = 3, C = 2, D = 1, F = 0) earned in school. ASU uses a 4.00 scale.
The average GPA of incoming students gives a sense of how competitive the college or university is.
The SAT is a standardized test used for college admission in the U.S. The SAT tests math, reading and writing.
Register for the test with College Board.
